officialReceiverDocumentation.semantics: GD:B selects the resource identity. Garden availability is separate GD:T.
WM:B counts gold in units of500. Zero marks the wheel as visited.
ML:B takes resource identity and amount separately.
UN:U enumerates the surface before underground, in diagonals shown by the official coordinate diagram: (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(2,0),(1,1),(0,2).
